They are the vicious but faithful servants of the [[Firelord]] and his minions.  They have the appearance of a massive [[dog]], with a mouth filled with rows of flaming teeth. Their body is covered with armored hide and the head is studded with bony spikes. A streak of flames runs down their spine from head to stubby tail.
